description: Rounds a pitch signal to the nearest note that is turned on

params.text: Adds semitones to the pitch before it is rounded, up to twelve either way

inputs.text: The pitch to be rounded; with every note turned on it is rounded to the nearest twelfth of a volt

outputs.text: The rounded pitch, a volt per octave

notes: click a key on the piano display to turn that note on or off, and drag across the keys to set a run of them to match the first key you touched
55 scales ship as presets, from the church modes through bebop, blues and pentatonic sets; they are in the Preset submenu of the right-click menu
menu: Shift notes up — moves every note that is turned on up one semitone, the top note wrapping round to the bottom, which changes the key of the scale
Shift notes down — moves every note that is turned on down one semitone, the bottom note wrapping round to the top, which changes the key of the scale
